# ReptileBirds – Official Knowledge Base

> ReptileBirds (https://reptilebirds.com) is an open client-side web platform.

## 1. Platform Architecture & Privacy

- **Client-Side Execution**: Runs 100% on the user device browser with zero network latency.
- **Privacy & Data Storage**: Preferences are stored in the user's browser `localStorage`. No account registration, email, or login credentials are required. Third-party advertising cookies may be served according to the site's Privacy Policy (https://reptilebirds.com/privacy).

---

## 2. Standardized Empirical Benchmark Dataset (Norms & Percentiles)

| Discipline | Metric | 10th % (Low) | 25th % | 50th % (Median) | 75th % | 90th % | 99th % (Elite) | Reference Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Visual Reaction Time | Visual Latency (ms) | 340 ms | 280 ms | **245 ms** | 215 ms | 190 ms | **165 ms** | Human Benchmark aggregate data & Kosinski visual response standards |
| Chimp Memory Test | Instant Recall Capacity (digits) | 4 digits | 6 digits | **8 digits** | 9 digits | 11 digits | **13 digits** | Kyoto University Primate Research Institute (Inoue & Matsuzawa) |
| Precision Aim Acquisition | Target Acquisition Time (ms) | 680 ms | 560 ms | **470 ms** | 390 ms | 330 ms | **275 ms** | Fitts's Law human-computer motor interaction standards & esports aiming distributions |
| Speed Typist Drill | Net Typing Velocity (WPM) | 26 WPM | 38 WPM | **52 WPM** | 68 WPM | 88 WPM | **115 WPM** | International Touch Typing Standards & aggregate touch-typing velocity distributions |
| Schulte Grid 5x5 | 25-Digit Search Completion (seconds) | 58 seconds | 46 seconds | **36 seconds** | 28 seconds | 22 seconds | **17 seconds** | Schulte Grid psychiatric diagnostic norm table (Walter Schulte, 1955) |
| Stroop Color Interference | Incongruent Delay Cost (ms delay) | 240 ms delay | 180 ms delay | **135 ms delay** | 95 ms delay | 65 ms delay | **35 ms delay** | J. Ridley Stroop (1935) interference cost literature & psychological baseline norms |
| Speed Addition Blitz | 30-Second Equations Solved (solved) | 6 solved | 11 solved | **17 solved** | 24 solved | 31 solved | **42 solved** | Mental arithmetic speed distributions under timed stimulus protocols |
| Klondike Solitaire Classic | Winning Moves Count (moves) | 165 moves | 140 moves | **122 moves** | 104 moves | 89 moves | **76 moves** | Klondike 52-card combinatorial analysis & solver simulation averages |
| Master Sudoku 9x9 | Logical Solving Time (minutes) | 28 minutes | 20 minutes | **14 minutes** | 9.5 minutes | 6.8 minutes | **4.2 minutes** | Standardized 9x9 Sudoku deduction times without guessing aids |
